teaser: The citizen developer is the spreadsheet grown up: the best briefs ever written, handed to villagers and town planners, carried in versioned vaults.
core_idea: Citizen developers, the employees, owners and experts who now build full applications, are good news rather than a risk: they are the evolution of the error-prone but indispensable spreadsheet, their working apps are the best briefs ever written, and the real work is the handover from explorer to villagers and town planners who add the non-functional requirements; encrypted, versioned vaults carry a mini app and its data through that handover, and the shift moves people and organisations from rent-seeking software towards tools and business models they choose.

quotes.text: Every department will now have people building software the way they build spreadsheets
quotes.why: The earlier article this one answers.

quotes.text: Of 54 spreadsheets audited between 1997 and 2000, no fewer than 49 were found to contain significant errors
quotes.why: How badly the old tool served its builders.

figures.caption: From the spreadsheet to the town planners: the citizen developer's path. People built with what they controlled, a spreadsheet; now they build the application they need, which is also the best brief ever written; villagers harden it and town planners make it scale, and an sgit vault carries the app and its data through every handover.
